lead.headline: Coker is still on your bench — the projection wants him back
lead.deck: Saturday afternoon changed nothing against you; Theo Johnson's downgrade hands Likely every tight-end snap. The only gap is Metcalf over Coker, 0.6 the wrong way.
lead.body: Start with your own move: since 12:15 Friday Jalen Coker has sat on the bench with DK Metcalf in the flex, and at the 22:05Z snapshot it is still that way. The projection prefers Coker 15.5 to 14.9 — a coin flip, but one it takes — and Saturday's reports from Carolina and Pittsburgh gave no reason to go the other way. The day's one change on your teams helps: the Giants ruled out tight end Theo Johnson, so Isaiah Likely has the position to himself against Houston. Rico Dowdle is still questionable for Paris, which can only help Jaylen Warren. Allen, Tuten and Diggs are on bye. ESPN has you at 62% over JuiceJam. Nothing on the wire clears the bar.
